[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 28.14, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the champion perovskite-organic tandem solar cell (PO-TSC) attains an exceptional PCE of 28.14% (certified 27.84%)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 27.84, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the champion perovskite-organic tandem solar cell (PO-TSC) attains an exceptional PCE of 28.14% (certified 27.84%)"},
    "pce_stabilised": {"value": 27.86, "unit": "%", "anchor": "with steady power output of 27.86% (certified 27.59%)"},
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.09, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "27.25% (1.55 eV, 0.09 cm²)"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "BiOCl deposited on SAMs induces a crystalline HSL with dipole flipping and long-range in-plane periodic alignment.", "anchor": "This HSL exhibits a crystalline order characterized by dipole flipping and long-range periodic alignment in in-plane direction, driven by π-π interactions among carbazole units.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Chlorine from BiOCl undergoes chlorine-iodine exchange at the buried interface, modulating perovskite crystallization and weakening electron-phonon coupling.", "anchor": "The chlorine from BiOCl undergoes a chlorine-iodine exchange at the buried interface, modulating perovskite crystallization and weakening electron-phonon coupling.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The tandem device retains 90% of initial efficiency over 600 h of MPPT under one-sun illumination.", "anchor": "The device retains 90% of its initial efficiency under continuous maximum power point tracking with one-simulated-sun illumination over 600 hours.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "tandem_4T",
    "absorber": "CsPb0.6Sn0.4I3 / CsPb0.7Sn0.3IBr2",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 20.36, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving a total scanned PCE of 20.36%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "4-ASA co-assembled with Me-4PACz on NiOx induces intermolecular interactions that inhibit SAM aggregation and micelle formation.", "anchor": "We demonstrated that 4-ASA induces intermolecular interactions with Me-4-PACz, inhibiting SAM aggregation and micelle formation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "NBG inorganic PSCs with co-SAM interlayer achieve a scanned PCE of 17.82%.", "anchor": "the NBG Pb-Sn-based inorganic PSCs achieve a scanned power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 17.82% with outstanding ultraviolet irradiation and operational stability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The first 4T perovskite tandem with both subcells based on Cs-based Pb-Sn mixed inorganic absorbers achieves 20.36% total PCE.", "anchor": "we demonstrate the first four-terminal (4 T) perovskite tandem device in which both subcells are based on Cs-based Pb-Sn mixed inorganic absorbers, achieving a total scanned PCE of 20.36%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.32, "unit": "%", "anchor": "resulting in power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 26.32% (certified as 25.67%) and 25.34% for areas of 0.08 cm2 and 1 cm2, respectively."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 25.67, "unit": "%", "anchor": "resulting in power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 26.32% (certified as 25.67%) and 25.34% for areas of 0.08 cm2 and 1 cm2, respectively."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.08, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "resulting in power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 26.32% (certified as 25.67%) and 25.34% for areas of 0.08 cm2 and 1 cm2, respectively."},
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A quantitative AFM-IR protocol was developed to determine the surface coverage of SAM layers.", "anchor": "A quantitative protocol based on atomic force microscope-infrared spectroscopy (AFM-IR) has been developed to determine the surface coverage of SAM layers.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The encapsulated device retains 93% of its initial PCE after 1150 h MPP operation under ISOS-L-1.", "anchor": "The encapsulated device retains 93% of its initial PCE after operating at the maximum power point (MPP) for 1,150 hours, as evaluated following the ISOS-L-1 protocol.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Symmetry-breaking co-assembly of MeO-2PACz with DTCA improves co-SAM uniformity and coverage, suppressing interfacial chemical reaction and non-radiative recombination.", "anchor": "When the surface coverage of co-SAM layers is maximized, the interfacial chemical reaction under electrical stress and the non-radiative recombination loss are effectively suppressed, resulting in power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 26.32%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "module",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 27.7, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving power conversion efficiencies of 18.1% and 27.7%, respectively."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 25, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "We further validate the approach in 25 cm² single-junction minimodules and perovskite/silicon tandem devices"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Incorporating isopropanol into a conventional low-polarity antisolvent accelerates and homogenizes perovskite crystallization.", "anchor": "By incorporating isopropanol into a conventional low-polarity antisolvent, we accelerate and homogenize perovskite crystallization through enhanced polarity and improved interaction with precursors and deposition solvents.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "In situ GIWAXS and PL reveal larger, more uniformly distributed crystalline nanodomains during static binary-antisolvent treatment.", "anchor": "In situ grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering and photoluminescence reveal the formation of larger, more uniformly distributed crystalline nanodomains during static treatment with the binary antisolvent.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Replacing aromatic antisolvents with ethyl acetate preserves film quality while improving sustainability.", "anchor": "The method is effective for four perovskite compositions under 30% relative humidity, and replacing aromatic antisolvents with eco-friendly ethyl acetate preserves film quality while improving sustainability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.54, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the resulting device achieves a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.54% and a certified steady-state efficiency of 26.03%."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.03, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the resulting device achieves a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.54% and a certified steady-state efficiency of 26.03%."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Partial substitution of lead with lanthanum increases perovskite Young's modulus from 27.96 to 35.71 GPa.", "anchor": "the strategy obviously enhances the perovskite stiffness with Young's modulus increasing from 27.96 to 35.71 GPa.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Lattice hardening reduces thermal expansion, suppresses defect formation and ion migration, mitigating non-radiative recombination and structural degradation.", "anchor": "The enhanced lattice stiffness reduces the thermal expansion coefficient, suppresses defect formation and ion migration, thereby mitigating non-radiative recombination and structural degradation under external stress.", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "Optimized devices retain >95% and >90% of initial efficiency after 1000 h at 65°C 1-sun and under damp-heat, respectively.", "anchor": "The optimized devices retain >95% and >90% of their initial efficiencies after 1000 hours of continuous 1-sun illumination at 65°C and under damp-heat conditions, respectively.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.76, "unit": "%", "anchor": "enabling a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.76% (certified 26.45%) in PSCs."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.45, "unit": "%", "anchor": "enabling a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.76% (certified 26.45%) in PSCs."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Cross-linkable SAMs functionalized at the molecular linker exhibit impressive conductivity and optimal energy level alignment after in situ cross-linking.", "anchor": "Upon in situ cross-linking, these hybrid monolayers exhibit impressive conductivity and optimal energy level alignment, enabling a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.76% (certified 26.45%) in PSCs.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PSCs with cross-linkable SAMs retain 99% of initial PCE after >2000 h thermal stress and 95% after 500 h UV irradiation.", "anchor": "The perovskite solar cells with cross-linkable SAMs also demonstrate superior durability in ageing tests, retaining 99% of its initial PCE under more than 2000 hours thermal stress and 95% of that under 500 hours ultraviolet irradiation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The cross-linkable SAM strategy has been applied to fabricate high-efficiency rigid and flexible mini-modules.", "anchor": "Furthermore, the strategy has been applied in the fabrication of high-efficiency rigid and flexible mini-modules.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 27.7, "unit": "%", "anchor": "we achieved power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 27.7% (certified 27.4%) in small-area (0.06 cm 2 ) cells and 20.1% in 2.0 m 2 modules"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 27.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "we achieved power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 27.7% (certified 27.4%) in small-area (0.06 cm 2 ) cells and 20.1% in 2.0 m 2 modules"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.06, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "we achieved power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 27.7% (certified 27.4%) in small-area (0.06 cm 2 ) cells and 20.1% in 2.0 m 2 modules"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "SAM acidity triggers a DMSO-mediated iodide redox reaction during processing, representing a universal bottleneck for inverted devices.", "anchor": "during processing, these SAMs inevitably contact perovskite inks, where their acidity triggers a dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)-mediated iodide redox reaction that imprints device performance, representing a universal bottleneck for inverted devices.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Hydrazide additives abrogate DMSO activation and redirect unwanted by-products toward benign hydrazide–formamidinium adducts.", "anchor": "These additives abrogate DMSO activation and redirect unwanted by-products toward benign hydrazide–formamidinium adducts.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "T95 lifetimes reach ~2000 h MPPT at 85°C and ~1500 h MPPT at 85°C/85% RH.", "anchor": "along with T95 lifetimes of ~2000 hours of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) at 85°C and ~1500 hours MPPT at 85°C and 85% relative humidity.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.13, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized devices deliver a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.13% with an outstanding open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 1.187 V."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "MOF-808 serves as a heterogeneous nucleation scaffold while CsHCOO confined in its porous channels regulates perovskite crystallization kinetics.", "anchor": "the MOF-808 framework serves as a heterogeneous nucleation scaffold, while CsHCOO molecules confined within the porous channels regulate perovskite crystallization kinetics, promoting preferential crystal growth and enabling the formation of highly crystalline perovskite films with enlarged grain sizes.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The composite interlayer eliminates oxygen vacancies and undercoordinated Pb²⁺ defects at the SnO₂/perovskite buried interface.", "anchor": "the composite interlayer chemically interacts with the SnO2 surface and perovskite bottom interface, effectively eliminating oxygen vacancies and undercoordinated Pb2+ defects, thereby suppressing interfacial non-radiative recombination.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices maintain 83.2% of initial efficiency after 300 h damp-heat aging at 85°C/85% RH.", "anchor": "allowing the devices to maintain 83.2% of their initial efficiency after 300 h of damp-heat aging at 85 °C and 85% relative humidity.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.19, "unit": "%", "anchor": "driving a ~10% relative increase in PCE from 20.13% (control) to 22.19%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Bromide-rich perovskite nanocrystals modify 3D perovskite film surfaces via self-driven solid-state halide exchange.", "anchor": "we report a novel, scalable interface engineering strategy utilizing bromide-rich perovskite nanocrystals to modify 3D perovskite film surfaces via self-driven solid-state halide exchange.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The resulting surface-graded heterojunction passivates iodide vacancies, suppresses ion migration, and optimizes charge extraction.", "anchor": "The resulting surface-graded heterojunction passivates key iodide vacancies, suppresses ion migration, and optimizes charge extraction.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Modified PSCs show improved fill factor of 75.3% and ~10% relative PCE increase from 20.13% to 22.19%.", "anchor": "modified PSCs demonstrate a ~5% boost in short-circuit current density () and an improved fill factor of 75.3%, driving a ~10% relative increase in PCE from 20.13% (control) to 22.19%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 20.31, "unit": "%", "anchor": "planar n-i-p devices incorporating the composite HTL deliver an enhanced power conversion efficiency of 20.31 %"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "MAPb(IₓBr₁₋ₓ)₃ nanocrystals incorporated into Spiro-OMeTAD HTL deliver Voc up to 1.1 V and photocurrent density of 24.62 mA cm⁻².", "anchor": "Consequently, planar n-i-p devices incorporating the composite HTL deliver an enhanced power conversion efficiency of 20.31 %, highlighted by a surge in 𝑉𝑜𝑐 (up to 1.1 V) alongside stable photocurrent density of 24.62 mA cm −2 .", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "EIS reveals that nanocrystal incorporation reduces bulk resistance of the Spiro-OMeTAD layer.", "anchor": "Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) reveals that NC incorporation results in reduced bulk resistance of the Spiro-OMeTAD layer.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Halide-ion redistribution modulates interfacial energetics and enhances the built-in electric field, contributing to PCE improvement.", "anchor": "systematic analysis of the characteristic time constant extracted from EIS measurements provides evidence of halide-ion redistribution which modulate the interfacial energetics and enhance the built-in electric field, thereby contributing to the observed improvement in PCE.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "FASnI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.06, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized device achieved a peak PCE of 26.06%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Cu-doped NiOx as HTL in FASnI3 PSC improves hole extraction and suppresses carrier losses.", "anchor": "copper (Cu) doped nickel oxide (NiOx) is employed as the hole transport layer (HTL) in a formamidinium tin iodide (FASnI3) perovskite solar cell to improve hole extraction and suppress carrier losses.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "Optoelectronic response evaluated via coupled FDTD optical simulations and FEM electrical modeling yields 24.71% PCE before ARC.", "anchor": "The optoelectronic response of the proposed device architecture is evaluated through a coupled numerical framework combining finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) optical simulations with finite element method (FEM)-based electrical modeling.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "Anti-reflection coating yields 5.47% relative PCE enhancement to peak 26.06% with Jsc 28.98 mA/cm², Voc 1.051 V, FF 85.64%.", "anchor": "Integrating an anti-reflection coating (ARC) effectively suppressed reflection losses, yielding a 5.47% relative enhancement in PCE.", "evidence_type": "simulation"}
    ]
  }
]
